questions.question: According to an international study, oceans absorbed the most heat on record in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **An international study reported that oceans absorbed the highest amount of heat ever recorded in 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The study, published in Advances in Atmospheric Sciences, found a rise of 23 zettajoules in ocean heat content.**
 
• **This heat gain is equivalent to 37 years of global energy use at 2023 consumption levels.**
 
• **The upper 2,000 metres of oceans recorded the highest heat content, confirming a long-term warming trend.**
 
• **Fastest warming was observed in the Tropical & South Atlantic, North Pacific, and Southern Ocean.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The study involved over 50 scientists from 31 institutions across Asia, Europe and the Americas.**
 
• **Sea-surface temperatures in 2025 were the third highest on record, intensifying floods, droughts and extreme weather.**

questions.question: Recently, scientists discovered a giant black coral believed to be 300–400 years old. Where was this coral discovered?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiordland waters off New Zealand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Marine scientists discovered the largest known black coral during a deep-sea dive in the waters of Fiordland, New Zealand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The giant black coral was discovered in the deep waters of Fiordland, New Zealand.**
 
• The coral is more than 13 feet tall and about 15 feet wide.
 
• It is estimated to be around 300 to 400 years old, making it one of the oldest known corals.
 
• The discovery was made by a scientific team from Victoria University of Wellington.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Black Coral__

 __
 
• A slow-growing deep-sea coral species known for long lifespans.
 
• Though named black coral, it appears white due to living tissue.
 
 
 
• Fiordland__
 __
 
• A remote coastal region in southwestern New Zealand.
 
• Known for deep fjords, rich marine biodiversity and protected ecosystems.
 
 
 
• Conservation Status__
 __
 
• Black corals are protected under New Zealand’s Wildlife Act.
 
• It is illegal to damage or collect them deliberately.
 
 
 
• Scientific Significance__
 
 
• Large and old corals act as important breeding sources.
 
• Mapping their locations helps protect fragile deep-sea ecosystems.

questions.question: India signed its 8th Free Trade Agreement with the European Union at the 16th India–EU Summit in Jan 2026. India has not signed a Free Trade Agreement with which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India and the European Union concluded the India–EU Free Trade Agreement at the 16th India–EU Summit, making the EU India’s 22nd FTA partner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India signed its 8th Free Trade Agreement with a European bloc by concluding the India–EU FTA at the 16th India–EU Summit.**
 
• Since 2014, India has signed trade agreements with **Mauritius, UAE, Australia, UK, EFTA, and Oman**.
 
• In 2025, India signed trade deals with **the United Kingdom and Oman** and announced the conclusion of a trade deal with **New Zealand**.
 
• India **has not signed a Free Trade Agreement with Japan**, making it the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• India’s recent FTAs focus on trusted partners, services trade, MSMEs, and global value chain integration.
 
 
 
• India–EU Free Trade Agreement__
 __

• Provides preferential market access to over 99 percent of Indian exports to the EU.
 
 
 
• European Union__
 
 
• A 27-member economic bloc.
 
• India’s one of the largest trading partners in goods and services.

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission even before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Assam became the first state in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission, with the decision announced by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 8th State Pay Commission of Assam was constituted before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission, which ends on January 1, 2026.**
 
• The commission is chaired by **Subhas Das**, former Chief Secretary of Assam.
 
• The Pay Commission will review **salaries, allowances, and pensions** of state government employees.
 
• The revision will consider **inflation, economic conditions, and the state’s fiscal capacity**, potentially leading to faster pay revision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Pay Commission__

 __
 
• A Pay Commission is a government-appointed body that reviews and recommends changes in pay structure of government employees.
 
• It examines salaries, allowances, pensions, and service conditions.
 
• Recommendations are advisory in nature and require government approval.
 
 
 
• Implementation Timeline__
 __
 
• Pay Commission reports generally take around **18 months** to be finalized.
 
• Actual implementation in Assam is expected in **late 2026 or early 2027**.
 
 
 
• Significance of Assam’s Decision__
 
 
• Assam moved ahead of other states and the Centre, where the **8th Central Pay Commission** has not yet been initiated.
 
• The early setup may benefit employees and pensioners through quicker revisions.

questions.question: The Pralay missile, whose salvo launch was recently conducted as part of user evaluation trials, is best described as which type of missile system?

options.text: Intercontinental ballistic missile with nuclear warhead

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indigenously developed solid-propellant quasi-ballistic missile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DRDO successfully conducted a salvo launch of two Pralay missiles off the coast of Odisha as part of user evaluation trials.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Pralay is an indigenously developed, solid-fuel, quasi-ballistic tactical missile.**
 
• Both missiles followed the intended trajectory and met all mission objectives.
 
• The trials were monitored by tracking sensors of the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur.
 
• The missile is intended for induction into the Indian Army and the Indian Air Force with conventional warheads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Quasi-Ballistic Missile__

 __
 
• Follows a lower and flatter trajectory than traditional ballistic missiles.
 
• Capable of manoeuvring during flight to evade missile defence systems.
 
• Combines features of ballistic flight with limited in-flight course correction.
 
 
 
• Pralay Missile__
 __
 
• First tested in December 2021.
 
• Employs advanced guidance and navigation systems for high precision.
 
• Can carry different types of conventional warheads against diverse targets.
 
 
 
• Development Agencies__
 
 
• Developed by DRDO’s Research Centre Imarat, Hyderabad.
 
• Supported by multiple laboratories including ARDE, HEMRL and R&DE (Engineers).
 
• Industry partners include Bharat Dynamics Limited and Bharat Electronics Limited.

questions.question: The Somnath Swabhiman Parv commemorates 1,000 years since what event?

options.text: First recorded attack on Somnath Temple

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**First recorded attack on Somnath Temple.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Somnath Swabhiman Parv is observed from January 8 to 11 in Somnath, Gujarat, commemorating 1,000 years since the first recorded attack on the historic Somnath Temple.**
 
• The first recorded major attack on the Somnath temple was in January **1026 CE**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

• **Location: Somnath, Gir Somnath district, Gujarat.**
 
• **Spiritual Significance: Somnath Temple is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• **Historical Importance: Commemorates 1,000 years since the first recorded attack on the temple.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The festival celebrates the resilience and cultural heritage of the Somnath Temple over a millennium.**
 
• **The temple has been historically attacked multiple times and rebuilt, symbolizing faith and perseverance.**
 
• **Somnath is a major pilgrimage site, attracting devotees from across India and abroad.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana launched by the Punjab government?

options.text: It provides free cashless medical treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family across Punjab
It is applicable only to senior citizens and government employees
It covers treatment exclusively in government hospitals without private sector participation
It is limited only to below poverty line families with an annual cover of ₹5 lakh

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It provides free cashless medical treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family across Punjab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Punjab government launched the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana, a universal health insurance scheme offering cashless treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana provides free cashless healthcare coverage of up to ₹10 lakh per family.**
 
• The scheme covers all 65 lakh families in Punjab, benefiting nearly three crore residents.
 
• Eligibility requires possession of an Aadhaar card and voter card, making it a universal scheme.
 
• More than 2,500 medical procedures are covered across government and empanelled private hospitals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana__

 __
 
• A universal health insurance initiative launched by the Punjab government.
 
• Aims to ensure free and quality healthcare for every resident of the state.
 
 
 
• Cashless Healthcare__
 __
 
• Allows patients to receive treatment without paying upfront costs.
 
• Expenses are settled directly between hospitals and the government or insurer.
 
 
 
• Universal Health Coverage__
 __
 
• Ensures all individuals have access to essential health services.
 
• Focuses on affordability, accessibility and quality of care.
 
 
 
• Aam Aadmi Party Governance Model__
 
 
• Emphasises free healthcare, free education and welfare-oriented public services.
 
• The scheme fulfills AAP’s pre-election health guarantee.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the President’s Police Colour Award:

Statement 1: This is the highest honour to be bestowed upon any military unit of India, also known as Sashakt, symbolising bravery and dedication, and is worn on the left sleeve of the uniform.

Statement 2: Sikkim Police became the 11th state to receive this honour in January 2026 in recognition of its outstanding service and professionalism.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither Statement 1 nor Statement 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• **The President’s Police Colour Award is the highest honour bestowed upon a police force in India, not a military unit.**
 
• The award is known as Nishaan and symbolises bravery, discipline and dedication.
 
• Sikkim became the 15th state overall and the 3rd state in the North East to receive this honour.
 
• The insignia of the award is worn on the left sleeve of the police uniform.

• President’s Police Colour Award__

 __
 
• A prestigious national honour awarded to police forces for exceptional service and professionalism.
 
• Only a limited number of states have received this award since Independence.
 
 
 
• Nishaan__
 __
 
• The ceremonial flag and insignia associated with the President’s Police Colour.
 
• Formally presented during a Colour Presentation Parade.
 
 
 
• Sikkim Police__
 
 
• Its recognition marks a landmark achievement in the state’s law enforcement history.
 
• The honour reflects excellence in discipline, service and dedication to duty.

questions.question: The “Womaniya Initiative” was recently in the news. What is it all about?

options.text: A credit guarantee scheme to provide collateral-free loans to women entrepreneurs under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
A skill development mission focused on training rural women in digital literacy under the STEM framework
A social security initiative providing pension support to women Self-Help Groups
A flagship programme of Government e-Marketplace to promote participation of women-led MSME in public procurement

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A flagship programme of Government e-Marketplace to promote participation of women-led Micro and Small Enterprises in public procurement.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Government e-Marketplace marked seven years of the Womaniya Initiative, which aims to strengthen the participation of women-led Micro and Small Enterprises in public procurement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Womaniya is a flagship initiative of the Government e-Marketplace to promote women-led MSE participation in government procurement.**
 
• It was launched on 14 January 2019 to provide women entrepreneurs direct digital access to government buyers.
 
• As of January 2026, over two lakh women-led MSEs are registered on GeM under the initiative.
 
• These enterprises have secured public procurement orders exceeding ₹80,000 crore, surpassing the mandated three per cent procurement target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Government e-Marketplace__

 __
 
• An online platform for public procurement by central and state government departments.
 
• It ensures transparency, efficiency and competitive pricing in government purchases.
 
 
 
• Women-led Micro and Small Enterprises__
 __
 
• Enterprises owned or led by women entrepreneurs.
 
• They are eligible for special procurement support under government policies.
 
 
 
• Public Procurement Policy__
 __
 
• The Government mandates a minimum share of procurement from women-owned enterprises.
 
• The Womaniya initiative helps exceed this target through digital enablement.
 
 
 
• Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Vocal for Local__
 
 
• National initiatives aimed at boosting domestic manufacturing and entrepreneurship.
 
• Womaniya aligns with these goals by supporting women entrepreneurs in government markets.

questions.question: As per the data released in January 2026, the unemployment rate for females in India stood at ____ in urban areas and ____ in rural areas in December 2025.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**9.1% and 3.9%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Unemployment data for December 2025 was released in January 2026 highlighting urban and rural trends.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Urban female unemployment rate stood at 9.1% in December 2025.**
 
• **Rural unemployment remained steady at 3.9% during the same period.**
 
• Urban female unemployment eased from 9.3% in November 2025.
 
• Overall unemployment rate for persons aged 15 and above was recorded at 4.8%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Urban Female Unemployment__

 __
 
• It represents the share of unemployed women actively seeking jobs in urban areas.
 
• Urban female unemployment tends to be higher due to sectoral concentration in services.
 
 
 
• Rural Female Employment Trends__
 __
 
• Rural employment is largely influenced by agriculture and allied activities.
 
• Lower unemployment rates reflect seasonal and informal employment patterns.
 
 
 
• Labour Force Participation Rate__
 __
 
• It measures the proportion of the working-age population participating in the labour market.
 
• The rate rose to 56.1% in December 2025.
 
 
 
• Worker Population Ratio__
 
 
• It indicates the percentage of employed persons in the total population.
 
• The ratio touched a yearly peak of 53.4%.
